amendment_reason: Adds provenance and standing geometry diagnostics without changing any v0.2 primary gate or threshold. External Fable replays are direction-setting only until regenerated under local receipt discipline.
object: cross-context high-occupancy eigenspaces of mean projectors for frozen low-frequency bands of normalized reliability-weighted sheaf Laplacians
selection_rule: choose the lowest-frequency band meeting the geometry gate in frozen band order; outcome-based band selection is prohibited

geometry_gate.occupancy_margin: minimum_occupancy minus 0.75; margins below 0.10 emit a fixture-calibrated warning but do not change the gate

policy_gate.realized_ic: standardized_uplift / sqrt(2 * realized_KL), reported per fold and averaged as a descriptive cap-sensitivity only; it is not an equivalent primary gate when folds do not bind at one common cap

direct_edit_gate.application: prohibited_in_discovery_stage; emit normalized proposal and hash only

sparse_geometry_noise.compatibility: noise 0.0 must be bit-identical to v0.2 fixture generation
sparse_geometry_noise.construction: context-specific orthogonal rotation within the leading 2r block; CSR outside that block
sparse_geometry_noise.rng_stream_note: noise 0.0 preserves the legacy RNG stream and is a compatibility baseline, not a paired sweep point; positive-noise comparisons use the smallest positive level as their reference

receipt_requirements.fixture_derived_comparison: bit equality when environment is pinned
receipt_requirements.external_replays: must record source archive SHA-256 and remain diagnostic-only

claim_boundary: A pass identifies a stable spectral bundle useful for grouped prediction and bounded candidate allocation. It does not establish real-model self-improvement, compactification, or RSI.
